# TypeScript 7 Skill for AI Coding Agents

> Agent Skill that teaches Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, and other coding agents to write, migrate, and diagnose TypeScript 7.0.2 — the native Go tsc (Corsa), not a new type system. Covers tsgo, native-preview, Strada, missing createProgram API, ignoreDeprecations, --checkers, and 7.0 defaults.

This repository is the skill. Start at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) after confirming TypeScript 7 is in scope. Humans start at [README.md](README.md). Pin: TypeScript 7.0.2 and VS Code/Cursor extension TypeScriptTeam.native-preview 0.20260708.2.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Human landing page, install prompts, FAQ
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Agent router (load this when the skill fires)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Instructions for agents working in this repository
- [references/sources.md](references/sources.md): Pin, primary sources, license boundary
- [scripts/probe.mjs](scripts/probe.mjs): Local-only compiler/scope probe for consumer projects

## Write, migrate, diagnose

- [references/writing-typescript.md](references/writing-typescript.md): Write .ts / .tsx / .d.ts under 7.0 defaults
- [references/migrating-to-7.md](references/migrating-to-7.md): Explicit 5.x or 6.0 → 7.0.2 migration
- [references/diagnosing-failures.md](references/diagnosing-failures.md): CLI red, emit wrong, tool load, editor ≠ tsc
